reviews.author: Jorge Gatica
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Car-Box. I was on a long trip with my wife and the engine of my car was shaking really bad. This happened on a Saturday. I showed up without an appointment David dropped what he was doing to help us. He diagnosed, found the issue, got the parts and repair my car within a couple of hours. I'm extremely grateful Car-Box and Mr. David.

reviews.author: Mary Paz
reviews.text: My husband and I highly recommend David's work, we went to many places where they couldn't find the problem with my car and we only spent money without any results, David solved the problem in a couple of days and now he is our trusted mechanic.

reviews.author: Wesley Robison
reviews.text: Have an 07 Navigator w/cam phasers and timing going bad. They gave me a great quote and his work is amazing. Almost like driving a different vehicle now. Highly recommended. Thank you.

reviews.author: Marco Ramos Ramos
reviews.text: David did a very good job on my car, he replaced my old engine with a newer one and my car was left in a perfect shape! I would recommend him to anyone 100% !

reviews.author: Miguel Garcia
reviews.text: I was visiting NC and my car had problems, the attention was a success and the repair better did more than agreed!

reviews.author: Angeles Manzano
reviews.text: My husband took our Nissan Rogue in and he did an excellent job. David is a very kind person and always keeps you informed about the progress of your car. He also repaired a friend's truck... 100% recommended!

reviews.author: Fran Ma
reviews.text: Very friendly, skilled, and experienced staff. I took my car here, and they were able to fix a problem that other mechanics couldn't. Compared to other shops, it's much more affordable. It's worth it; I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Carlos Javier Cartagena Cartagena
reviews.text: I was having engine trouble with my car, and they did a great job repairing it here. The mechanic is clearly very skilled with all types of gasoline engines, and the best part is that the service includes all the parts.

reviews.author: Fransua Polanco
reviews.text: I always take my car to this shop when it needs assistance or maintenance...the service is excellent, 100% recommended

reviews.author: Mario Fernández
reviews.text: It's the best workshop in the area because of the quality and reliability of their work. They also provide excellent customer service. I highly recommend them.
